name: rocq
description: The Rocq Prover is an interactive theorem prover, or proof assistant. It provides a formal language to write mathematical definitions, executable algorithms and theorems together with an environment for semi-interactive development of machine-checked proofs.

issues.title: On OS X, Coq with native-compiler is too slow
Parallelism of proof processing in async mode?
"destruct" cannot use injection patterns top-level (but it can nested)
native_compute (and vm_compute) is about 14x-16x slower (about 25x-27x, resp.) than extraction+ocamlopt
Qed time is quadratic (sharing of sub-terms is not detected)
Citation instructions for Coq should be up to date and in the README.md
